newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 24.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* The Dow Jones Industrial Average ends 2.47 percent lower after a sell-off triggered by Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's comment about sale of U.S. Securities by Japan.
* The KL Composite Index fell 8.56 points at 1,088.98.
* Focus seen on banking stocks with main activity in MBf Capital, which relists after being disallowed to negotiate merger with Suria Capital.
* Taiping Consolidated, Malpac Holdings to see action after surging to 12-month highs on Monday.
* "With New York having had such a rough night ... I think it will be a little negative (in KL)," said Ralph Dixon at TA Securities's international division.
* Brokers said after the Dow fall and with most of foreign community focusing on Hong Kong ahead of the handover to China, the lacklustre trend in Kuala Lumpur would continue.
* Shares of MISC may face some selling after Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd, managed by a son of Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, denied rumours about acquiring a stake in the state-run company.
